inlines.text: 今天，Anthropic, PBC 为其拟议的 A 类普通股首次公开募股启动了路演。

blocks.text: 本次拟议发行包括 825,000,000 股 A 类普通股。其中，801,351,354 股由 Anthropic 发行，23,648,646 股由部分现有股东发行。Anthropic 不会从售股股东出售的股份中获得任何收益。Anthropic 还预计将授予承销商一项 30 天期权，可额外购买最多 123,750,000 股 A 类普通股。

blocks.text: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

inlines.text: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

blocks.text: The proposed offering consists of 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock. Of these, 801,351,354 shares are being offered by Anthropic and 23,648,646 shares are being offered by certain existing stockholders. Anthropic will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling stockholders. Anthropic also expects to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 123,750,000 shares of its Class A common stock.

blocks.text: The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share. Anthropic has applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.”
